```{r setup}

params <- list(seurat_integrated = './3_Integration/data/2024-01-12/integration/seurat_combined_sct.rds',  
    sample_name = "renamed_cluster", output_dir = "./3_Integration")

packages = c("tidyverse","Seurat", "AnnotationHub", "janitor", "tidydr",
             "reshape", "DT", "cowplot", "patchwork", "forcats", "ggplot2")

for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}
```

```{r path}

))
```

# Data input
```{r load_data}
seurat.combined.sct = readRDS('./3_Integration/data/2024-01-12/integration/seurat_combined_sct.rds', refhook = NULL)
Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- 'integrated_snn_res.0.5'
png(filename = paste0(results_dir,"/umap_0509.png"), width = 5, height = 5, units = "in", res=500)
DimPlot(seurat.combined.sct, reduction = "umap", label = T)
dev.off()

DT::datatable(as.matrix(table(seurat.combined.sct$seurat_clusters)), colnames = c("cluster", "number of cells"))
```

# Sequencing quality
```{r Sequencing_quality}

#if (!require(devtools)) {
	#install.packages('devtools')
#}
#devtools::install_github('erocoar/gghalves',force = TRUE)
library(gghalves)

data <- data.frame(nCount_RNA = seurat.combined.sct$nCount_RNA)
data_melted <- melt(data, variable.name = "Metric", value.name = "Value")
colnames(data_melted) <- c("Metric", "Value")
sampled_data <- data_melted %>% sample_frac(0.05)
p1<- ggplot(sampled_data, aes(x = Metric, y = Value, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_half_violin(aes(fill = Metric),
                   position = position_nudge(x = .15, y = 0),
                   adjust=1.5, trim=FALSE, colour=NA, side = 'r') +  # 小提琴部分
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = Metric, y = Value, fill = Metric),
               outlier.shape = NA,
               width = .05,
               color = "black") +  # 添加箱线图
  geom_point(aes(x = as.numeric(Metric)-0.1,
                 y = Value, color = Metric),
             position = position_jitter(width = .05),size = .25, shape = 20)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("nCount_RNA" = "#1f78b4", 
                               "nFeature_RNA" = "#33a02c", 
                               "percent.mt" = "#e31a1c")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("nCount_RNA" = "#1f78b4", 
                                "nFeature_RNA" = "#33a02c", 
                                "percent.mt" = "#e31a1c")) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::scientific) +
  labs(title = "nCount_RNA",
       x = "",
       y = "Total UMI Counts per Cell") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
    title = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```

# Clustering and annotation
```{r Clustering}
seurat.combined.sct <- NormalizeData(seurat.combined.sct, assay = "RNA")
DefaultAssay(seurat.combined.sct) <- "RNA"

assignment_df <- data.frame(
  cluster = c("10","15","0",
              "13",
              "1","2","9","11",
              "5","6","7","8","12","14","17",
              "16",
              "19",
              "4","18","20",
              "3"), 
  renamed_cluster = c(rep("ASPC",3), 
                      rep("Mesothelial Cell",1),
                      rep("Endothelial Cell",4),
                      rep("Macrophage",7),
                      rep("Dendritic Cell", 1), 
                      rep("Neutrophil", 1), 
                      rep("B Cell",3),
                      rep("T Cell",1)
                    )
            )
print(assignment_df)

assignment_df$renamed_cluster = as.character(assignment_df$renamed_cluster)

# combine the dataframe by `cluster`
temp_meta <- seurat.combined.sct@meta.data %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "barcode") %>% 
  left_join(assignment_df, by = c("seurat_clusters" = "cluster")) %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "barcode")
seurat.combined.sct$renamed_cluster <- temp_meta[rownames(seurat.combined.sct@meta.data),"renamed_cluster"]
Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- 'renamed_cluster'
levels(seurat.combined.sct) <- c("Macrophage","Endothelial Cell","ASPC","B Cell","T Cell",
                                 "Mesothelial Cell","Dendritic Cell","Neutrophil")
DT::datatable(as.matrix(table(seurat.combined.sct$renamed_cluster)), colnames = c("cell type", "number of cells"))
saveRDS(seurat.combined.sct, "./3_Integraton/data/2024-05-10/seurat_combined_sct_umap_renamed.rds")
```

```{r celltype}
mycol <- c( "#F39B7FB2", "#e7b24f", "#91D1C2B2", "#4DBBD5B2", "#8491B4B2",  "#ad66a9", "#DC0000B2", "#00A087B2","#ff69b4")
```

# Statistical stacked barplot (number & percent)
```{r cell_number_plot}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
seurat.combined.sct <- readRDS("./3_Integration/data/2024-05-10/seurat_combined_sct_umap_renamed.rds")
Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- "renamed_cluster"
levels(seurat.combined.sct) <- c("Macrophage","Endothelial Cell", "ASPC", "B Cell","T Cell","Mesothelial Cell","Dendritic Cell","Neutrophil","Smooth Muscle Cell")
levels(seurat.combined.sct)

seurat.combined.sct$DE_group <- paste0(seurat.combined.sct$renamed_cluster, "-", seurat.combined.sct$sample)
seurat.combined.sct$DE_group <- as.factor(seurat.combined.sct$DE_group)
saveRDS(seurat.combined.sct, "./3_Integration/data/2024-05-10/seurat_combined_sct_umap_renamed.rds")

data_table <- as.data.frame(table(seurat.combined.sct$DE_group))
data_table$groups <- rep(c("Chow","HFSC"),9)
colnames(data_table) = c("Cell Types","Numbers","Groups")
data_table <- data_table %>%
  mutate(`Cell Types` = sub("-.*", "", `Cell Types`))
df_wide <- data_table %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Groups, values_from = Numbers)
df_wide$`Cell Types` <- factor(df_wide$`Cell Types`, levels = c("Macrophage","Endothelial Cell", "ASPC", "B Cell","T Cell","Mesothelial Cell","Dendritic Cell","Neutrophil","Smooth Muscle Cell"))
df_wide <- df_wide %>% 
  arrange(`Cell Types`)
write.csv(df_wide,"./3_Integration/results/2024-05-10/adipose cluster cell number.csv", row.names = F,quote = F)

data_cluster <- as.data.frame(table(seurat.combined.sct$renamed_cluster))
colnames(data_cluster) = c("Cell Types","Numbers")

# Stacked + percent
mycol <- c( "#F39B7FB2", "#e7b24f", "#91D1C2B2", "#4DBBD5B2", "#8491B4B2",  "#ad66a9", "#DC0000B2", "#00A087B2","#ff69b4")

data_cluster$`Cell Types` <- factor(data_cluster$`Cell Types`, levels = rev(c("Macrophage","Endothelial Cell", "ASPC", "B Cell","T Cell","Mesothelial Cell","Dendritic Cell","Neutrophil","Smooth Muscle Cell")))
C <- ggplot(data_cluster, aes(fill=`Cell Types`, y=`Cell Types`, x=Numbers)) + 
    geom_bar(stat="identity") + theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=5, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=8)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(mycol)) + NoLegend()
# ggsave("./3_Integration/results/2024-05-10/cellnumber_cluster.pdf", width = 3, height = 4)

data_table$`Cell Types` <- factor(data_table$`Cell Types`, levels = rev(c("Macrophage","Endothelial Cell", "ASPC", "B Cell","T Cell","Mesothelial Cell","Dendritic Cell","Neutrophil","Smooth Muscle Cell")))
C2 <- ggplot(data_table, aes(fill=`Groups`, y=`Cell Types`, x=Numbers)) + 
    geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat="identity") + theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=5, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=8)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(mycol)) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = Numbers)) +
  NoLegend()
C2

data_table$`Cell Types` <- factor(data_table$`Cell Types`, levels = c("Macrophage","Endothelial Cell", "ASPC", "B Cell","T Cell","Mesothelial Cell","Dendritic Cell","Neutrophil","Smooth Muscle Cell"))
D <- ggplot(data_table, aes(fill=`Cell Types`, y=Numbers, x=Groups)) + 
    geom_bar(position="fill", stat="identity") + theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=5, colour = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=8, colour = "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mycol) + NoLegend()   # + coord_flip()

# ggsave("./3_Integration/results/2024-05-10/cellnumber_percent.pdf", width = 3, height = 4)
combined_plot <- C + D + plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1)) + 
  plot_annotation('Number & Percent of scRNA-seq Clusters', 
                        theme = theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5,size = 12)))
ggsave("./3_Integration/results/2024-05-10/cellnumber_info.pdf", combined_plot, width = 2.7, height = 2.5)
```

# Feature Plot for Cell Types Markers
```{r feature_plot}
library(pheatmap)

seurat.combined.sct <- readRDS("./3_Integration/data/2024-05-10/seurat_combined_sct_umap_renamed.rds")
Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- "renamed_cluster"
cluster.aver <- AverageExpression(seurat.combined.sct, assays = 'RNA', group.by = "renamed_cluster", verbose = T)

DefaultAssay(seurat.combined.sct) <- "RNA" 
Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- "renamed_cluster"
levels(seurat.combined.sct) <- c("Macrophage","Endothelial Cell", "ASPC", "B Cell","T Cell","Mesothelial Cell","Dendritic Cell","Neutrophil","Smooth Muscle Cell")
levels(seurat.combined.sct)
seurat.combined.sct <- JoinLayers(seurat.combined.sct)
markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat.combined.sct, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
markers <- data.frame(geneid = rownames(markers), markers)
# write.csv(markers,file = sprintf('./3_Integration/results/2024-05-10/cell_marker.csv'), row.names = F)

markers = read.csv('./3_Integration/results/2024-05-10/cell_marker.csv')
top10 <- markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC) 
top10$cluster <- factor(top10$cluster, levels = c("Macrophage", "Endothelial Cell", "ASPC", "B Cell", "T Cell",  "Mesothelial Cell", "Dendritic Cell", "Neutrophil","Smooth Muscle Cell"))
write.csv(top10, file = sprintf('./3_Integration/results/2024-05-10/cell_marker_top10.csv'), row.names = T)
top20 <- markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 20, wt = avg_log2FC) %>% arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE)
top20$cluster <- factor(top20$cluster, levels = c("Macrophage", "Endothelial Cell", "ASPC", "B Cell", "T Cell",  "Mesothelial Cell", "Dendritic Cell", "Neutrophil","Smooth Muscle Cell"))
#write.csv(top20, file = sprintf('./3_Integration/results/2024-05-10/cell_marker_top20.csv'),row.names = T)

heatmap_input <- as.data.frame(cluster.aver$RNA)
heatmap_input$geneid = rownames(heatmap_input)
heatmap_input <- heatmap_input[,c("geneid","Macrophage","Endothelial Cell", "ASPC", "B Cell","T Cell","Mesothelial Cell","Dendritic Cell","Neutrophil","Smooth Muscle Cell")]
heatmap_input <- heatmap_input[top10$gene,]
#library(ComplexHeatmap)
#anno <- rowAnnotation(
#  foo = anno_mark(at = c(1:,10:15,20:25,30:35,40:45,50:55,60:65,70:75),
#  labels = top10$gene[c(1:5,10:15,20:25,30:35,40:45,50:55,60:65,70:75)]))
#pdf("./3_Integration/results/2024-05-10/markers_heatmap_long_top10_new.pdf", width = 5, height = 5)
#Heatmap(
#  heatmap_input,
#  cluster_rows = FALSE,
#  cluster_columns = FALSE,
#  name = "map",
#  right_annotation = anno)
#dev.off()
heatmap_input$geneid <- factor(heatmap_input$geneid, levels = rev(unique(heatmap_input$geneid)))
heatmap_input <- melt(heatmap_input, id.vars = "geneid")
E <- ggplot(heatmap_input, aes(y = variable, x = geneid, fill= log10(value+0.01))) +
```

# Differential Expression Analysis for Cell Types
## input_data
```{r DEA_input}
seurat.combined.sct <- readRDS("./3_Integration/data/2024-05-10/seurat_combined_sct_umap_renamed.rds")
table(seurat.combined.sct$DE_group)
table(seurat.combined.sct$renamed_cluster)
DefaultAssay(seurat.combined.sct) <- "RNA"
Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- "DE_group"

# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# Define the cell types
cell_types <- c("Macrophage", "Endothelial Cell", "ASPC", "B Cell", "T Cell", "Mesothelial Cell", "Dendritic Cell", "Neutrophil","Smooth Muscle Cell")
# Define the conditions
condition1 <- "HFSC"
condition2 <- "Chow"
# Initialize an empty list to store data frames
markers_list <- list()
# Loop through each cell type and perform the operations
for (cell_type in cell_types) {
  # Join the layers (if needed, you might skip this if it's already done)
  seurat.combined.sct <- JoinLayers(seurat.combined.sct)
  # Create the identifiers for the conditions
  ident1 <- paste(cell_type, condition1, sep = "-")
  ident2 <- paste(cell_type, condition2, sep = "-")
  # Find markers
  markers <- FindMarkers(object = seurat.combined.sct, ident.1 = ident1, ident.2 = ident2)
  # Convert markers to data frame and arrange by adjusted p-value
  markers_df <- markers %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>% 
    arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
    mutate(CellTypes = cell_type)
  # Save the results
  saveRDS(markers_df, file = file.path("./3_Integration/results/2024-05-10/DEAnalysis", paste(cell_type, "-DEMarkers.rds", sep = "")))
  # Append the data frame to the list
  markers_list[[cell_type]] <- markers_df
}
# Combine all data frames in the list into one data frame
combined_markers_df <- bind_rows(markers_list)
write.csv(combined_markers_df,"./3_Integration/results/2024-05-10/DEAnalysis/combined_markers_df.csv",row.names = F)

combined_markers_df <- read.csv("./3_Integration/results/2024-05-10/DEAnalysis/combined_markers_df.csv")
# Display the combined data frame
combined_markers_df_P0.1 <- combined_markers_df %>%
  filter((avg_log2FC > 1 | avg_log2FC < -1) & p_val < 0.1)
table(combined_markers_df_P0.1$CellTypes)
multiVolcano_input <- combined_markers_df_P0.1[,c("gene","p_val","avg_log2FC","CellTypes")]
colnames(multiVolcano_input) <- c("Name","PValue","logFC","Cluster")
```

## MultiVolcano Plot
```{r DEA}
# 自定义一个函数，之后我们直接调用它
#加载包
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)   # 用于标记

mycol <- c( "#F39B7FB2", "#e7b24f", "#91D1C2B2", "#4DBBD5B2", "#8491B4B2",  "#ad66a9", "#DC0000B2", "#00A087B2","#ff69b4")

# 自定义一个函数，之后我们直接调用它
mutiVolcano = function(df,         # 绘图数据
                       P,   # P值卡值
                       logFC,   # logFC卡值
                       GroupName,      # 分组标签
                       pointColor, # 分组散点的颜色
                       barFill = "#efefef",  # 柱子的颜色
                       pointSize = 0.5,      # 散点的大小
                       labeltype = "1",      # 标记差异基因的选项，标记类型有"1"和"2"两种选项
                       labelNum = 5,         # 当标记类型为1时，待标记的散点个数
                       labelName = NULL,      # 当标记类型为2时，待标记的散点名称
                       tileLabel =  "Label", # 标记比较对的选项，选项有“Label”和“Num”，Label时显示分组名称，Num时显示数字，防止因为标签太长导致的不美观
                       tileLable_size,
                       tileColor = NULL      # 比较对的颜色
                       ){
  # 数据分组 根据p的卡值分组
  dfSig = df %>%
    filter(logFC>{{logFC}} | logFC <((-1)*{{logFC}})) %>%
    mutate(Group = ifelse(PValue<{{P}},GroupName[[1]],GroupName[[2]])) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group,levels=GroupName)) %>%
    mutate(Cluster = factor(Cluster,levels=unique(Cluster)))   # Cluster的顺序是文件中出现的顺序
  
  # 柱形图数据整理
  dfBar = dfSig %>%
    group_by(Cluster) %>%
    summarise(min = min(logFC,na.rm = T),
              max = max(logFC,na.rm = T)
              )
  # 散点图数据整理
  dfJitter = dfSig %>%
    mutate(jitter = jitter(as.numeric(Cluster),factor = 2))
  dfJitter
  
  # 整理标记差异基因的数据
  if(labeltype == "1"){
    # 标记一
    # 每组P值最小的几个
    dfLabel = dfJitter %>%
      group_by(Cluster) %>%
      slice_max(abs(logFC),n=labelNum,with_ties = F) %>%
      ungroup()
  }else if(labeltype == "2"){
    # 标记二
    # 指定标记
    dfLabel = dfJitter %>%
      filter(Name %in% labelName)
  }else{
    dfLabel = dfJitter %>% slice()
  }
    
  # 绘图
  p = ggplot()+
    # 绘制柱形图
    geom_col(data = dfBar,aes(x=Cluster,y=max),fill = barFill)+
    geom_col(data = dfBar,aes(x=Cluster,y=min),fill = barFill)+
    # 绘制散点图
    geom_point(data = dfJitter,
               aes(x = jitter, y = logFC, color = Group),
               size = pointSize,
               show.legend = NA
               )+
    # 绘制中间的标签方块
    ggplot2::geom_tile(data = dfSig,
                       ggplot2::aes(x = Cluster, y = 0, fill = Cluster), 
                       color = "black",
                       height = 1.5,
                       # alpha = 0.3,
                       show.legend = NA,
                       ) + 
    # 标记差异基因
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = dfLabel,
      aes(x = jitter,                   # geom_text_repel 标记函数
          y = logFC,          
          label=Name),        
      min.segment.length = 0.1,
      max.overlaps = 10000,               # 最大覆盖率，当点很多时，有些标记会被覆盖，调大该值则不被覆盖，反之。
      size=2.5,                             # 字体大小
      box.padding=unit(0.5,'lines'),      # 标记的边距
      point.padding=unit(0.05, 'lines'), 
      segment.color='black',              # 标记线条的颜色
      show.legend=F)
  
  if(tileLabel=="Label"){
     p =
      p +
      geom_text(data = dfSig,aes(x = Cluster,y = 0,label = Cluster),size = tileLable_size)+
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = tileColor,
                                 guide = NULL # 不显示该图例
                                 )
  }else if(tileLabel=="Num"){
    # 如果比较对的名字太长，可以改成数字标签
    p =
      p +
      geom_text(data = dfSig,aes(x = Cluster,y = 0,label = as.numeric(Cluster)),show.legend = NA)+
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = tileColor,
                                 labels = c(paste0(1:length(unique(dfSig$Cluster)),": ",unique(dfSig$Cluster))))
  }

  # 修改主题
  p = p+ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = pointColor)+
    theme_classic()+
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 5) + 
    ggplot2::theme(
                   legend.position = "right", 
                   legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(), 
                   legend.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                   # axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                   axis.line.x = element_blank()
                   ) + 
    ggplot2::xlab("Clusters") + ggplot2::ylab("log2FC") + 
    # ggplot2::guides(fill = ggplot2::guide_legend())
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))
    return(p)
}

df <- as_tibble(multiVolcano_input)
# Run multiVolcano
mutiVolcano(
  df = df,    # 绘图数据
  P = 0.05,   # P值卡值
  logFC = 1,   # FC卡值
  GroupName = c("P-value < 0.05","P-value >= 0.05"),      # 分组标签
  pointColor = c("#dc143c","#0099CC"), # 分组散点的颜色
  barFill = "#efefef",   # 柱子的颜色
  pointSize = 0.3,       # 散点的大小
  labeltype = "1",       # 标记差异基因的选项，标记类型有"1"和"2"两种选项
  labelNum = 5,          # 当标记类型为1时，待标记的散点个数
  labelName =c(""),   # 当标记类型为2时，待标记的散点名称
  tileLable_size = 2.8,
  tileLabel =  "Label",           # 标记比较对的选项，选项有“Label”和“Num”，Label时显示分组名称，Num时显示数字，防止因为标签太长导致的不美观
  tileColor = mycol   # 比较对的颜色
)

ggsave("./3_Integration/results/2024-05-10/DEAnalysis/mutiVolcano.pdf", width = 11.5, height = 5)
```

```{r AUCell}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly=TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install("Biobase")
library(Biobase)

getwd()

#Run AUCell
Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- "renamed_cluster"
combined.small <- subset(seurat.combined.sct, downsample = 3000)
fmeta <- data.frame(symbol = rownames(combined.small)) 
rownames(fmeta) <- fmeta$symbol
eset_combined.small <- new("ExpressionSet",
                           assayData = assayDataNew("environment", exprs=combined.small@assays$RNA@layers$counts, 
                                                    norm_exprs = combined.small@assays$RNA@layers$data),
                           phenoData =  new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = combined.small@meta.data),
                           featureData = new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = fmeta))
exprMatrix <- exprs(eset_combined.small)
geneSets <- getGmt("./AUCell/mh.all.v2023.2.Mm.symbols.gmt")
geneSets <- subsetGeneSets(geneSets, rownames(exprMatrix)) 
cbind(nGenes(geneSets))
geneSets <- setGeneSetNames(geneSets, newNames=paste(names(geneSets)))

# add random noise
# Random
set.seed(321)
extraGeneSets <- c(
  GeneSet(sample(rownames(exprMatrix), 50), setName="Random (50g)"),
  GeneSet(sample(rownames(exprMatrix), 500), setName="Random (500g)"))
countsPerGene <- apply(exprMatrix, 1, function(x) sum(x>0))
# Housekeeping-like
extraGeneSets <- c(extraGeneSets,
                   GeneSet(sample(names(countsPerGene)[which(countsPerGene>quantile(countsPerGene, probs=.95))], 100), 
                           setName="HK-like (100g)"))
geneSets <- GeneSetCollection(c(geneSets,extraGeneSets))
names(geneSets)

# 1. Score gene signatures
# cells_AUC <- AUCell_run(exprMatrix, geneSets)

cells_rankings

# 1.2 Calculate enrichment for the gene signatures (AUC)
cells_AUC <- AUCell_calcAUC(geneSets, cells_rankings)
save(cells_AUC, file="./AUCell/AUCecells_AUC.RData")

set.seed(123)
```

```{r dot_complement}
markers.to.plot = complement.Hallmarkers
markers.to.plot = c("C3","C3ar1","Itgam","Itgb2","Cr2","C4b")

markers.to.plot = c("C1qa", "C1qc", "C1r", "C1s", "C3", "C3ar1", "C4b", "C4bpb", "C9", "Casp1", "Cd59", "Cfb", "Cfh", "Cr1", "Cr2", "Itgam", "Itgax", "Itgb2", "Pla2g7", "Serping1")

p
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

markers <- c("Vcam1", "Pecam1", "Acta2", "Il6", "Il9")

# Cross Table
markers <- c("Vcam1", "Pecam1", "Acta2", "Il6")

dot.data <- DotPlot(seurat.combined.sct, 
                    features = markers, 
                    group.by = "renamed_cluster")$data %>%
  dplyr::select(features.plot, id, avg.exp, pct.exp) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Gene              = features.plot,
    sample            = id,
    AvgExpression     = avg.exp,
    PercentExpressing = pct.exp
  )

# ① AvgExpression Cross Table
avg_table <- dot.data %>%
  select(Gene, sample, AvgExpression) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Gene, values_from = AvgExpression)

avg_table

# ② PercentExpressing Cross Table
pct_table <- dot.data %>%
  select(Gene, sample, PercentExpressing) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Gene, values_from = PercentExpressing)

pct_table

# ③ Specificity Score Cross Table (Aavg.exp × pct.exp
score_table <- dot.data %>%
  mutate(SpecificityScore = AvgExpression * PercentExpressing) %>%
  select(Gene, sample, SpecificityScore) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Gene, values_from = SpecificityScore)

score_table

write.csv(score_table, "./delivery/marker_expression_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
